steps.name: pnpm-check-and-Capacitor-Gradle-for-Ionic-BLE-scan
steps.command:
set -eu
git fetch origin work/ux-evolution
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/work/ux-evolution)"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo "SOURCE=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo 'PNPM_CHECK_START'
pnpm check > /tmp/shelly-ionic-BLE-173-check.log 2>&1 || {
 echo PNPM_CHECK_FAILED
 grep -E 'Test Files|Tests |FAIL|Error|budget' /tmp/shelly-ionic-BLE-173-check.log | tail -95 || true
 tail -85 /tmp/shelly-ionic-BLE-173-check.log
 exit 42
}
echo 'PNPM_CHECK_PASS'
grep -E 'Test Files|Tests |Performance budget|Performance review|threshold exceeded|budget passed' /tmp/shelly-ionic-BLE-173-check.log | tail -50 || true
echo 'CAPACITOR_SYNC_ANDROID_DEBUG_BUILD'
pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile exec cap sync android
SDK="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}}"
printf 'sdk.dir=%s\n' "$SDK" > apps/mobile/android/local.properties
(cd apps/mobile/android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --quiet)
APK=apps/mobile/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
test -s "$APK"
echo "APK_SHA256=$(shasum -a 256 "$APK" | awk '{print $1}')"
echo "APK_BYTES=$(wc -c < "$APK" | tr -d ' ')"
echo "TREE";git status --short
